label: Quotient campaign Metrics tab (KPI tiles + traffic charts)
description: A Quotient CAMPAIGN's METRICS TAB, hand-built from the product: the campaign tab bar (Brief / Tasks / Activation / Deliverables / Metrics [active, underlined] / Chats) with a kebab and 'Go to thread' on the right; SIX KPI TILES with icons (Page Views, Sessions, Email Opens, Email Clicks, Social Impressions, Social Likes); two chart cards -- 'Traffic over time' (smoothed Page Views blue + Sessions green lines, legend, dated x-axis, gridlines, 'View data') and 'Traffic by deliverable' (vertical blue bars with truncated deliverable names, 'Top series only.', 'View data'); and the 'Want to dig deeper?' footer with 'Open reports ->' and a black 'Ask the agent' button. Every word and number comes from data (defaults: the Q3 Flows launch -- a campaign that took off at launch). ENTRANCE (on the timeline, scrub-safe): the card rises, tiles land with a stagger while their numbers ROLL UP (formatted), the chart cards rise, the lines DRAW left to right, the bars GROW from the baseline, the footer rises. data.at shifts it all; entrance:'none' shows the settled page from frame 0 (stills). SCRIPT verbs: count {target: tile label, to, display?, format?, duration?} rolls a tile from its current value to a new one; highlight {target: tile label | deliverable name | 'traffic' | 'deliverables' | tab | button text, duration?, color?} = accent ring + wash on a tile/card/tab/button (a tile's number turns accent), or on a deliverable bar: the other bars dim and a value tag pops above it; switch-tab {tab} moves the underline; set-text {target, text} swaps a tile label / bar name / tab / chart title / button text; plus the shared cursor verbs (move-cursor, click, hover, wait ...) whose target may be any of those names (tiles, tabs 'metrics', 'ask the agent', 'open reports', 'go to thread', 'view data', 'bar-3'). CAMERA ANCHORS: tabs, kpis, kpi-0..kpi-5, traffic, deliverables, footer. PLACEMENT: sized off its box (one native px of the product = min(boxW/1288, boxH/826)), so it reads the same at any size; the charts take the height left over. In the Quotient desktop: quotient-app-shell at x 1.2%, y 2%, width 97.6%, height 96% with show_panel:false, nav_active:'campaigns', breadcrumbs ['Campaigns', '<campaign name>'], and this component docked:true at x 4.7%, y 8%, width 93.7%, height 89% (z above the shell). Standalone (docked unset) it is a white rounded card with a visible border + shadow. Example data: {"docked": true, "kpis": [{"label": "Page Views", "icon": "eye", "value": 48210}, {"label": "Sessions", "icon": "activity", "value": 31904}, {"label": "Email Opens", "icon": "mail", "value": 15605}, {"label": "Email Clicks", "icon": "click", "value": 3284}, {"label": "Social Impressions", "icon": "globe", "value": 186420}, {"label": "Social Likes", "icon": "heart", "value": 4812}], "deliverables": [{"name": "Q3 launch email · Try Flows free", "value": 9840}, {"name": "Flows launch webinar", "value": 7420}], "script": [{"action": "count", "target": "Page Views", "to": 61480, "at": 3.5}, {"action": "highlight", "target": "Page Views", "at": 3.5, "duration": 1.8}, {"action": "highlight", "target": "Flows launch webinar", "at": 5}, {"action": "click", "target": "Ask the agent", "at": 6.5}]}

tabs.label: Campaign tabs: strings or {label, icon} (icons: brief, tasks, activation, deliverables, metrics, chats). Default Brief / Tasks / Activation / Deliverables / Metrics / Chats

show_thread.label: false hides the kebab + 'Go to thread' buttons

kpis.label: KPI tiles: [{label, icon (eye|activity|mail|click|globe|heart|users|trending|dollar|target|share|message|calendar|file), value: number (rolls up), display?: final text override e.g. '186K', format?: 'number'|'compact'|'percent'|'currency', decimals?, prefix?, suffix?}] -- six fill the row (default the Q3 Flows launch: Page Views 48,210, Sessions 31,904, Email Opens 15,605, Email Clicks 3,284, Social Impressions 186,420, Social Likes 4,812)

kpi_columns.label: Tiles per row (default: all in one row)

traffic.label: 'Traffic over time': {title?, series: [{name, color?, points: [numbers]}] (default Page Views blue + Sessions green, weekly), labels?: x labels -- one per point (every Nth is shown, plus the last) or a short list spread evenly, label_every?, y_max?}

deliverables.label: 'Traffic by deliverable' bars: [{name, value}] (names truncate under the bars; ~10 fit)

deliverables_note.label: Note under the bars (default 'Top series only.'; false hides it)

deliverables_y_max.label: Bar axis max (default: a nice number over the top bar)

show_legend.label: false hides the line chart legend

footer.label: Ask-the-agent footer: {title?, text?, secondary? ('Open reports'), primary? ('Ask the agent')}; false hides it

script.label: Timed actions [{action, at, ...}]: count {target, to, display?, format?, duration?}, highlight {target, duration?, color?}, switch-tab {tab}, set-text {target, text}, and cursor verbs move-cursor / click / hover / wait {target}

cursor_targets.label: Named cursor positions overriding the built-in element targets

at.label: Shift the whole entrance by this many seconds (negative starts it under a join)

entrance.label: 'none' = settled final state from frame 0 (stills); default plays the entrance

docked.label: true = sits flush in quotient-app-shell's content well (no outer border/shadow). Place at the shell's content region.
